rule.note: paired_A_MBON11 magnitude is set by lr (calibrated), not by the wiring; the wiring-derived claims are the unpaired specificity and the DN readout. Any lr>=~1 zeroes the MBON11 KC synapses, so the drop plateaus.

dn_readout_through_recurrent_brain.note: the max single-DN rate change is the honest test of whether the memory reaches steering; the L1 ratio pooled over the DN population (and even more the whole-brain one) dilutes it
